Hi again relief crew,
Greeting routines, at handover: a short note from our desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is steady today, and the records trail is in good order. Please keep the intake notes clear and brief, and carry forward any open cases without adding guesswork. When a caller or counter visitor reaches out, answer in a warm professional tone and keep the focus on the animal's travel needs.

Handlers continue to use calm, humane methods around animals, and that approach should stay consistent through the shift. The passenger coordinator will explain the required steps when a case needs more review, so send anything uncertain along without delay. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and small details in the file help the next person pick up cleanly.

If you see a gap in documents, log it at once and move on to the next task. The desk should stay orderly, patient, and easy to follow for the relief crew.
